g.text: EOF questionnaire - Page 1/3 : what the audit launches on its own
Everything below is triggered by the audit,
All these probes observe the service from the outside.
None of them talks to the team operating it.
The ceiling of this step is not a tooling defect.
Most of the 70 criteria concern internal facts
about the team: code reviews, tests, knowledge of
the target users. No technical datum reaches them.
These criteria come out as "no answer".
The report therefore only contains what was measured, never an
answer from the team operating the service.
